card.name: Time windows after "do not" or "avoid"
card.fires_on: The word "within", the number after it, or a similar unit word, inside a prohibition such as "Do not administer ... within 36 hours" or "avoid ... within 9 hours". It also fires on a few other restriction phrases.

modes.label: Within a time window
modes.description: "within" or the number or unit after it, in a ban on using a drug close to another drug or event.

modes.description: Words that finish an instruction to avoid a body area or a relationship.
